content.introduction: The sources provide mixed information on global stock market indices as of today, October 6, 2026. According to CNBC, the Nikkei 225 closed higher on June 9, 2026, with a gain of 1,414.73 points to 66,896.00, while the Hang Seng closed down by 640.98 points to 23,972.29 on October 2, 2026. Investing.com lists the Nikkei 225 at 68,309.46 with a loss of 647.26 points on October 2, 2026. The sources do not provide current data for all indices, and there is a discrepancy in the Nikkei 225's closing figures between the two sources.
